status_reason: Forge V2 Institutional Pipeline (REJECTED): Trades=95, WinRate=36.8%, BaseNet=-4.383%, StressNet=-6.677%, WF=2/4, EarlyCuts=2, NearTPSaves=15, TPExpansions=0, MC95 DD=11.91%.

atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for EURUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=4.039, trend_persistence=0.283, mean_reversion=0.717. Learned timeframe weights: D1 (w=+0.250), H4 (w=+0.250), M15 (w=+0.250). Ablation-retained features: dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.341), liquidity_sweep (w=+0.219), bos_breakout (w=+0.184), fvg_impulse (w=+0.175) (pruned/left out by ablation: ema_trend, rsi_momentum).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for EURUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=4.039, mean-reversion=0.717). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to D1 (w=+0.250), H4 (w=+0.250), M15 (w=+0.250). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.341), liquidity_sweep (w=+0.219), bos_breakout (w=+0.184), fvg_impulse (w=+0.175)] and pruned [ema_trend, rsi_momentum].
